note: Blunt, evidence-based final claim decisions. Unsupported claims are NOT upgraded.

benchmark_v2_non_circular.evidence: Strongest label-free trivial signal 0.6127 < 0.80 (artifacts/diagnostics/rf2_triviality_v2.json); subject-level splits (overlap 0); model_visible/audit/hidden_eval separation. Scoped: ontology-backed SYNTHETIC benchmark, not real-world.

real_ontology_integration.evidence: Real UMLS 2026AA / SNOMED CT / RxNorm parsed; MIMIC coverage diagnosis 0.80 / medication 0.78 (artifacts/phase2b_fix/). Canonical engine wired into scoring.

real_ontology_beats_legacy.evidence: ontology_only_real ROC-AUC 0.7881 vs legacy_baseline 0.7358; paired bootstrap +0.0524, CI [0.0325, 0.0718], p~0 (significant). artifacts/phase7/final_stat_tests.json.

detector_improves_detection.evidence: Full-scale unsupervised detector (Phase 6, 25 epochs, 20,570 normals) test ROC-AUC 0.4525 (BELOW chance). The v2 anomalies are relational, not next-token-surprising.

combined_beats_ontology_only.evidence: combined_real_without_sgen 0.7036 < ontology_only_real 0.7881; paired bootstrap -0.0845, CI [-0.0963, -0.0732], p~0 -> adding the detector SIGNIFICANTLY HURTS. Recommended main score = S_ont alone.

sgen_improves_detection.evidence: Phase 5 gate = remove_from_core: Sgen ROC-AUC 0.4868 (below chance), harms combined (paired -0.0175, p~0), mode-collapsed. w_gen=0 in the core.

counterfactual_leakage_free.evidence: Generator reads only model-visible sequence+demographics; leakage tests pass (answer keys change nothing; misleading keys ignored). Old circular logic deleted. tests/test_phase4_counterfactual_leakage.py.

counterfactual_effective_for_flagged.evidence: On benchmark-v2 test (1376 anomalies, 939 ontology-flagged): 89.99% valid repair among flagged; mean delta S_ont 0.644; median 1 edit. Per rule: medication 100%, forbidden 100%, demographic 65.7% (budget-limited). Scoped: ontology-violation resolution, not clinician-verified.

clinical_validity_external.evidence: No clinician validation performed. Validity = rule-based ontology-violation resolution, not clinical ground truth.

external_dataset_generalization.evidence: eICU present but uses APACHE/body-system tokens (0/500 records map to the ICD/SNOMED/RxNorm ontology). external_validation_blocked_schema_mismatch. Needs an APACHE->ICD/SNOMED crosswalk + eICU anomaly injection. artifacts/phase7/external_validation_status.json.

reproducible.evidence: Phase 6 config system + resumable training + experiment index + deterministic seeds; Phase 7 aggregate evaluation scripts. Licensed data / checkpoints git-ignored.

headline: Real ontology rules provide the main anomaly-ranking signal on benchmark-v2 (0.79, significantly > legacy 0.74). The unsupervised detector is below chance and non-additive for relational anomalies. Sgen is removed from the core. Counterfactual repair is leakage-free and effective (~90%) for ontology-flagged anomalies. External validation and clinical validation are future work.
